source_title: Intersignal LLC Announces Braid 2.1, Introducing "Memory Capsules" to Deliver Persistent, Cloud-Free Context for Local AI Nodes
source_excerpt:
FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Intersignal LLC, a leading developer of edge AI hardware architectures and decentralized communication protocols, today announced the release of Intersignal Braid 2.1. The latest version of the local-first LLM orchestration platform introduces Memory Capsules, a breakthrough capability that allows developers and self-hosted AI engineers to inject persistent, queryable context directly into local AI channels.
The introduction of Memory Capsules fundamentally solves the multi-rig context problem. By enabling a local AI instance to dynamically query a loaded memory capsule at any time, Braid 2.1 transforms siloed bare-metal nodes into a cohesive, stateful network. This allows for seamless cross-model semantic state transfer without any reliance on centralized cloud infrastructure.
"The release of Braid 2.1 and Memory Capsules represents a major leap forward for edge AI orchestration," said David Seaman, technical founder of Intersignal LLC. "For the first time, operators running open-weight language models on bare-metal clusters can maintain complex, shared context across their hardware. We are providing the essential infrastructure to make local AI not just fast and private, but truly stateful and collaborative."
The 2.1 release builds on a period of rapid development and deployment for the Braid architecture. Following the recent rollout of Intersignal Folio for static web publishing and the integration of wide-area network (WAN) capabilities via dedicated relay nodes in Braid Archangel, Memory Capsules serve as the critical memory layer for the ecosystem.
Designed for privacy-conscious enterprises, independent systems engineers, and off-grid compute deployments, Braid 2.1 ensures that sensitive data and model states remain entirely local. Whether orchestrated across modern Apple Silicon, high-performance Linux workstations, or legacy bridges, the Braid network continues to push the boundaries of what is possible in decentralized , peer-to-peer AI computing.
About Intersignal LLC Intersignal LLC specializes in edge AI hardware architectures, local-first LLM orchestration, and low-latency network relays. Through its proprietary Braid network and Pipeline delegation layers, Intersignal empowers users to deploy, manage, and scale open-weight artificial intelligence offline, ensuring absolute data sovereignty and operational resilience.
